stem: What can the reader infer from Mia's actions in paragraphs 8 through 12 in the story "The List"?

options.label: A
options.text: Mia is concerned that Amit is less skillful than she is at riding the unicycle.

options.label: B
options.text: Mia's questioning of Amit indicates that she is more determined than he is to ride the unicycle.

options.label: C
options.text: Mia is hesitant to admit to Amit that she needs his help in learning to ride the unicycle.

options.label: D
options.text: Mia's reluctance to ride with Amit indicates that she prefers to skip learning to ride the unicycle.
